title: Shortest and Lexicographically Smallest Beautiful String
sourceKind: web-search-snippets (official page not fetchable; mirrors leetcode.doocs.org and walkccc.me)
summary: Given a binary string s and a positive integer k, a substring is beautiful if it contains exactly k ones. Return the shortest beautiful substring, lexicographically smallest among ties, or an empty string if none exists.
officialConstraints: 1 <= s.length <= 100 and k >= 1 (length bound reported by a mirror; k range and character set not confirmed on the official page).
visualizationNotes: Sliding window over the string; the visual caps s at 100 characters and k at 100. The k bound is an assumption and the examples are from mirror snippets, so requirements are not marked verified.
